description:
**Job Description:** **About ETS:**


ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future\-ready. For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide.


Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.


**About the ETS Apprenticeship Program:**


ETS engages Apprentices under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) in compliance with the Apprenticeship Act. The goal is to provide practical training, foster skill development, and ensure compliance with the Apprenticeship Act, thereby enhancing employability and contributing to the organization's workforce development goals.


**About the Role**


We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Talent Management **Apprentice** who is eager to learn and build a strong foundation in Human Resources within a global organisation.


As an Apprentice, you will gain hands\-on exposure to various HR processes and initiatives while working closely with HR professionals and business stakeholders. The role will provide opportunities to develop your skills in HR operations, employee engagement, talent management, learning and development, and other HR initiatives.


The apprenticeship is designed to provide fresh graduates with practical corporate experience, professional skills, and a structured learning pathway. Depending on business and project requirements, the apprentice may also have the opportunity to gain exposure to different HR functions and projects. This is a contractual role of 1 year.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the HR team in day\-to\-day HR activities and operational processes.
* Assist with employee engagement initiatives, HR communications, and internal events.
* Support HR projects and initiatives across different areas of Human Resources.
* Assist in preparing HR reports, presentations, trackers, and other relevant documentation.
* Work with HR teams and stakeholders to gather information and support project requirements.
* Maintain and update HR data and records with accuracy and confidentiality.
* Support the coordination of meetings, training sessions, and other HR activities.
* Assist with Learning \& Development initiatives and employee development programmes.
* Support the team with data analysis and reporting using tools such as Excel and PowerPoint.
* Explore and leverage AI tools and technology to improve HR processes and productivity.
* Collaborate with team members and stakeholders and respond to queries in a timely and professional manner.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and projects and complete them within agreed timelines.
* Demonstrate curiosity and willingness to learn new HR processes, tools, and technologies.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow all applicable ETS policies and processes.

 **Experience and Skills:**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* Candidates pursuing or having completed an MBA/PGDM in Human Resources will be preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Good interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Strong willingness to learn and develop a career in Human Resources.
* Ability to work independently with minimal guidance while collaborating effectively with the team.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior internship experience in **Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Learning \& Development, or a related HR function**.
* Exposure to HR processes or corporate environments.
* Basic understanding of HR practices and employee lifecycle processes.
* Familiarity with AI tools and their application in the workplace.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast\-paced environment.

**Key Competencies**

* **Communication:** Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with different stakeholders.
* **Learning Agility:** Demonstrates curiosity and the ability to quickly learn new concepts, processes, and tools.
* **Ownership:** Takes responsibility for assigned tasks and follows through to completion.
* **Collaboration:** Works effectively with team members and stakeholders.
* **Adaptability:** Comfortable working on varied projects and supporting changing business needs.
* **Attention to Detail:** Maintains accuracy while working with HR data and documentation.
* **Technology Orientation:** Willingness to learn and use technology and AI tools to enhance productivity.
* **Initiative:** Proactively seeks opportunities to learn, contribute, and improve processes.

**What You Will Gain**


As an HR Apprentice at ETS, you will:


* Gain hands\-on experience in a global HR environment.
* Develop practical knowledge of HR processes and corporate practices.

description:
**Designation:** SENIOR EXECUTIVE
  

**Location:** India UTTAR PRADESH Noida
  

**Group:** DS Group
  

**Entity:** Dharampal Satyapal Strategic Consultants LLP
  

**SBU:** DHARAMPAL SATYAPAL STRATEGIC CONSULTANTS LLP
  

**Department:** INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
  

**Function:** DATA ANALYTICS
  

**Job Description:**
--------------------


Job Title: Graduate Trainee / Junior Data \& Analytics Engineer


Employment Level: Fresher / Entry Level

  

  

ROLE PURPOSE

  

  

We are looking for a curious, technically strong fresher who wants to build a career across data engineering, analytics, database management, and dashboard development. The role is suitable for recent graduates with excellent SQL fundamentals, strong Python programming ability, and a clear understanding of how data moves from operational systems into reporting and analytical solutions.


The selected candidate will work with experienced team members to build reliable data pipelines, validate and transform data, create dashboards, automate recurring activities, and help business teams make better decisions. Prior full\-time work experience is not required; however, candidates must be able to demonstrate their knowledge through academic projects, internships, personal projects, certifications, or a practical technical assessment.

  

  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


* Understand business requirements and convert them into clear data fields, source\-to\-target mappings, transformation rules, validation checks, and expected outputs.


* Write accurate and efficient SQL queries for data extraction, joining, aggregation, reconciliation, analysis, and reporting.


* Assist in building and maintaining data pipelines that move data between operational databases, files, APIs, data warehouses, and analytical platforms.


* Use Python to extract, clean, transform, validate, and load structured data.


* Develop reusable Python scripts and small applications for automation, reporting, data\-quality checks, and recurring analytical tasks.


* Build clear and user\-friendly dashboards using Python\-based visualization or dashboard frameworks and, where required, standard business\-intelligence tools.


* Analyse data to identify trends, exceptions, missing values, duplicates, inconsistent master data, and unusual business movements.


* Reconcile dashboard and report outputs with source data before release.


* Support incremental loads, scheduled jobs, error handling, logging, monitoring, and recovery of failed data\-processing tasks.


* Document database objects, pipeline logic, field definitions, business rules, assumptions, dependencies, and refresh schedules.


* Work with business users, analysts, and technology teams to troubleshoot data issues and improve the reliability of reporting.


* Follow secure coding, data\-access, version\-control, testing, and documentation practices.


* Continuously learn new data technologies and contribute ideas for improving automation, performance, and user experience.

  

  

MANDATORY TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE

  

  

1\. SQL and database fundamentals


* Very strong command of SQL, including joins, subqueries, common table expressions, window functions, grouping, conditional aggregation, set operations, date functions, and data\-cleaning logic.


* Ability to solve SQL problems involving duplicates, nulls, changing records, mismatched data types, multiple levels of granularity, and incomplete source data.


* Sound knowledge of relational database concepts, tables, keys, constraints, relationships, normalization, denormalization, views, indexes, and transactions.


* Basic understanding of query execution plans and the factors that affect database and query performance.


* Ability to design a simple database schema and explain why particular tables, keys, relationships, and indexes were selected.


* Strong interest in database management, data accuracy, data lineage, and source\-of\-truth controls.

  

  

2\. Python programming


* Strong programming fundamentals in Python, including functions, classes, modules, collections, file handling, exception handling, and reusable code design.


* Hands\-on knowledge of data\-processing libraries such as pandas and NumPy.


* Ability to connect Python applications to databases, execute parameterized queries, process files, and consume REST APIs.


* Understanding of logging, debugging, configuration management, virtual environments, testing, and basic performance considerations.


* Ability to write readable, modular, and documented code instead of one\-time scripts.


* Exposure to Python\-based dashboards or visualisation tools such as Streamlit, Plotly, Dash, Matplotlib, Seaborn, or similar frameworks.

  

  

3\. Data\-pipeline understanding


* Clear understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and the stages involved in extracting, validating, transforming, and loading data.


* Knowledge of batch processing, incremental loading, scheduling, dependencies, error handling, retries, audit fields, and reconciliation.


* Ability to explain how a data pipeline should prevent duplicate loads, identify failed records, and prove that the target data matches the source.


* Familiarity with data warehouses, analytical databases, data lakes, or modern data platforms is useful.


* Awareness of orchestration, monitoring, and data\-quality concepts will be an advantage.

  

  

4\. Dashboard and analytical thinking


* Ability to choose appropriate charts, filters, KPIs, drill\-downs, and layouts for a business question.


* Strong numerical and logical reasoning with the ability to understand what a metric means and why it may have changed.


* Ability to build simple interactive dashboards using Python and explain the data and calculation logic behind them.


* Exposure to any established business\-intelligence or reporting tool is useful, but strong Python, SQL, and data understanding are the priority.


* Good attention to usability, performance, accuracy, and clarity when presenting data.

  

  

QUALIFICATIONS

  

  

* B.E./B.Tech, BCA, MCA, B.Sc./M.Sc., or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline.


* Fresh graduates and candidates with internship experience may apply.


* Academic projects, personal projects, coding profiles, dashboards, database designs, or data\-pipeline demonstrations will be considered as valuable evidence of capability.


* Relevant certifications are welcome but will not replace practical knowledge.

  

  

WHAT WE VALUE

  

  

* Strong problem\-solving ability and willingness to investigate data instead of accepting results without validation.


* Curiosity about business processes and the ability to ask clear questions.


* Ownership, discipline, attention to detail, and a learning mindset.


* Clear written and verbal communication.


* Ability to explain technical work in simple language and collaborate respectfully with both technical and non\-technical colleagues.

  

  

SELECTION APPROACH

  

  

The selection process may include a practical assessment covering advanced SQL, database design, Python programming, data transformation, pipeline logic, data validation, and dashboard creation. Candidates may also be asked to explain one academic, internship, or personal project in detail, including the problem, data model, code, testing approach, and final outcome.

title: Software Tech Lead +
description:
FOR TECH ENTHUSIASTS, INNOVATORS \& VISIONARIES
At Constelli, we don't just build signal processing systems, we engineer the future of Defense and Aerospace technologies. If you're someone who thrives on complexity, innovation, and impact, this is where your journey begins.
We're a team of passionate engineers, researchers, and problem\-solvers driven by purpose and united by a shared vision: to develop real\-time electronically intelligent systems and advanced algorithms that empower mission\-critical platforms across India's defense ecosystem.
WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON
Whatever you're designing DSP algorithms, Architecting Telemetry Systems, Testing RF Platforms, or Simulating EW environment, your work at Constelli will matter. Our projects span:
Software \- defined Radar simulators.
Telemetry and Target Tracking System.
Sensor Fusion, Electronic Warfare \& AI\-enabled platforms.
Field Deployment of Critical Defense Infrastructure.
Who Thrives Here
Curious minds who go beyond job descriptions .
Engineers who love building systems from the ground up.
Innovators who turn edge cases into launchpads.
Freshers and interns from ECE/CSE/EIE backgrounds eager to learn and lead.
What You’ll Experience
End\-to\-End Ownership: From concept to deployment, your ideas take flight.
Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work shoulder to shoulder with experts in Hardware, Software, RF, and Systems Design.
Dynamic Culture: We believe great work happens when you're happy and heard.
Career Acceleration: Mentorship, real\-time feedback, and opportunities to lead from Day 1\.
  
#### **About Us**



We build mission\-critical software for the defence and aerospace sectors. Our teams bring together software engineers, RF and electronics specialists, and domain experts to deliver turnkey solutions for problems with no off\-the\-shelf answer, across tactical radios, radar systems, and applied research.



Much of our work sits around the systems that produce signal and sensor data — building the software that generates, validates, analyses, and visualises that data at scale. The common thread is volume under time pressure, and interfaces that let operators and analysts act on what they are seeing immediately.


#### **About the Role**



We're looking for a hands\-on Software Tech Lead to own the architecture and lead development of real\-time, data\-intensive systems across several projects — backend services and visualisation\-heavy frontends.



You'll set technical direction, own architectural decisions, review designs and code, and mentor the engineers around you — while still building the hard parts yourself. Your leverage comes from the quality of your technical judgement and how much you raise the level of the people you work with.



#### **Key Responsibilities**


**System design \& architecture**


* Own the architecture end to end — services, data flow, storage, and the backend/frontend contract.


* Design real\-time pipelines that hold up as data volume, concurrent sources, and complexity grow.


* Make and document the consequential calls: service boundaries, streaming versus batch, data modelling, where to spend the latency budget.


**Hands\-on engineering**


* Build backend services and APIs that process large volumes of sensor and signal data at low latency.


* Implement the data\-processing and analytics logic that turns raw data into real\-time insight.


* Work with event streaming (Kafka) and caching / inter\-service communication (Redis).


* Build and optimise data\-heavy frontend features — dashboards, charts, live visualisations — including state management and performance work for large datasets and live updates.


**Technical leadership \& mentorship**


* Set technical direction and bring the team along with the reasoning behind it.


* Review designs and code for correctness, performance, and maintainability — using review as a teaching mechanism, not a gate.


* Mentor engineers through hard problems, and raise the bar on testing, instrumentation, and the practices that keep a real\-time system debuggable under pressure.


**Delivery \& collaboration**


* Break requirements into workstreams and sequence them by priority, risk, and technical dependency.


* Run sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives, keeping the team unblocked and the plan honest.


* Work with data scientists, electronics engineers, and UI/UX to turn requirements into designs.


#### **Required Qualifications**


**Must\-haves**


* Full\-stack depth, currently hands\-on. You're building across backend and frontend today, with real depth in distributed systems, high\-throughput processing, and SQL or equivalent.


* System design at scale. You've shipped systems where architecture was the deciding factor, and can walk us through the tradeoffs you weighed.


* Full\-lifecycle ownership. You've taken multiple projects from requirements through design, build, release, and maintenance.


* Technical leadership. A team's technical direction has run through you — via design review, mentorship, and credibility rather than reporting lines.


* Languages. Hands\-on in one or more of C\+\+, C\# or Python, plus familiarity with React or Angular. We work across projects with different stacks, so breadth counts.


* Core stack. Production experience with event streaming and caching in a real\-time pipeline (Kafka and Redis, or equivalents), and with data\-intensive frontends.


* Experience. Bachelor's in Computer Science, Electronics, or equivalent practical experience, plus 6\+ years including substantial real\-time or data\-intensive work.


**Nice to have**


* Exposure to defence, aerospace, or another mission\-critical regulated domain.


* Familiarity with sensor or signal\-data concepts — enough to hold a productive conversation with our electronics engineers.


* Experience with time\-series data stores, or binary / columnar formats for moving large datasets efficiently.


* Experience introducing an architectural change into a live system without a rewrite.


#### **Why Join Us**


* Problems that resist easy answers. Real\-time constraints, large\-scale sensor data, and operational reliability requirements — on systems that get used.


* Architectural ownership from day one. Real design authority, not a role where the important decisions were made elsewhere.


* Depth alongside domain experts. You'll work directly with electronics and RF engineers, and pick up domain context that's hard to come by elsewhere.

We’re building AI systems that run a real business — and we need someone on the ground making sure they actually work.

We’ve built an AI “brain” for a thread and yarn distribution company. It looks at the business’s data every day and tells the owner what to buy, who owes money, and what’s going wrong — before he has to ask.

Your job is to be the bridge between that AI system and the real people using it:

* Learn how the business actually runs — talk to the staff, watch how orders and stock move.
* Check whether the AI’s suggestions were actually right, and figure out why when they’re not.
* Turn what you learn into clear notes for the AI/engineering team so they can fix it.
* Help the team actually start using it day to day — training, nudging, troubleshooting.
* Use AI tools yourself, all day, to move faster on all of the above.

*Basically: you sit where technology meets a real business, and you make sure the two actually work together.*

* Just finished college (or close to it) — any stream.

* Comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets.
* Curious about how businesses actually work, not just how software does.
* Ready to learn fast and figure things out with minimal hand\-holding.

**You do not need to know how to code.** You’ll be working with AI tools that write the code — your job is knowing what to build and whether it’s working.

**Why this is a great first job**

* You’ll work directly with the founder and the AI team — no layers in between.
* You’ll learn a real business inside out: buying, selling, stock, cash — in months, not years.

title: Data Scientist
job_function: Analyst, Product Management, and Project Management
description:
**About noon** 




 We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East\-fast, scalable, and deeply customer\-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we’re looking for a Data Scientist who can help us move even faster.
 



  





 Noon’s fastest hyper\-local delivery platform, Noon Minutes, offers a localized assortment of FMCG \& grocery products with delivery within 15\-minutes. Currently live across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, offering thousands of products to customers in record time.
 



  





 noon’s mission: Every door, every day
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




 Team noon has some of the fastest, smartest, and hardest\-working people we've encountered. With a young, aggressive, and talented team, we're driving major missions forward. As a Growth Data Scientist at noon Minutes, you will build the models and systems that power smarter customer engagement, promotional efficiency, and business performance\-working at the intersection of ML, experimentation, and commercial impact.
 


* Build and own ML models for customer segmentation, propensity scoring, and lifecycle prediction to enable targeted, high\-ROI growth interventions.
* Design and iterate on promotional optimisation systems\-modelling incrementality, testing coupon strategies across customer segments, and optimising budget allocation.
* Develop automated performance monitoring and anomaly detection pipelines that surface meaningful signals across key growth metrics.
* Design, analyse, and improve experimentation frameworks; ensure statistical rigour across A/B tests and incrementality studies.
* Work closely with product and engineering to take models from prototype to production\-you own the full lifecycle, not just the notebook.
* Translate complex model outputs into clear, actionable insights for commercial and product stakeholders.



  





**What you'll need:** 



* 1\-3 years of experience in data science or applied ML, ideally in a consumer technology or e\-commerce environment.
* Strong ML fundamentals \-clustering, classification, regression, ranking, and reinforcement learning / bandit algorithms.
* Proficiency in Python; experienced with standard ML and data libraries (scikit\-learn, XGBoost, pandas, etc.).
* Strong SQL skills; comfortable working with large\-scale transactional datasets independently.
* Solid understanding of causal inference and experimentation\- you know the difference between correlation and incrementality.
* Experience deploying models in production environments, not just research settings.
* Quick\-commerce, e\-grocery, or marketplace experience is a plus.



  





**Who will excel?** 



* We’re looking for people with high standards, who understand that hard work matters.
* You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action.
* We need people with the courage to be fiercely original.
* noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.

As financial industry experts at the center of markets and technology, we help our clients efficiently scale their business and quickly access markets. From infrastructure to connectivity, we support our clients through the full trading lifecycle. We are a global company headquartered in New York, with offices in Chicago, London, Singapore, Hong Kong and Tokyo.
   

  

 We are seeking a Power BI Developer as this role will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and the data engineering function, translating departmental reporting needs into scalable Power BI dashboards and reusable semantic models. The successful candidate will work with data sourced from Oracle, Salesforce and other business systems as these sources are integrated into the company data warehouse.

* Staying updated with the latest BI technologies and trends to continuously improve reporting capabilities and use of AI.

* Solid data modeling skills, including star schema design, relationship management, and modeling best practices.
* High proficiency in SQL for querying, data transformation, and data validation.
* Strong knowledge of dashboard performance tuning, DAX optimization, and data refresh strategies.
* Translate complex business requirements into robust, scalable BI solutions that are easy for departmental users to understand and adopt.

title: Cloud-Native Engineer/Consultant (m/w/d) – für Menschen, die wachsen wollen und andere mitnehmen
description:
Wir suchen keine fertigen Superhelden. Wir suchen Menschen, die Bock haben, mit uns gemeinsam besser zu werden. Die verstehen, dass gute Technik nur die halbe Miete ist – die andere Hälfte sind die Menschen, die sie bauen und nutzen.
   

  

**Was Uns Wichtig Ist (in Dieser Reihenfolge)**
* Du kannst und willst lernen
* Du denkst mit – nicht nur technisch, sondern auch unternehmerisch
* Du verstehst, dass die beste Lösung nichts wert ist, wenn das Team sie nicht trägt


**Was Du Bei Uns Machst**
 Von Technical Due Diligence über Cloud\-Architekturen bis zu CI/CD\-Pipelines – die Bandbreite ist groß. Aber keine Sorge: Niemand erwartet, dass du alles kannst. Was wir erwarten: Dass du Lust hast, es zu lernen.
   

  

**Ein Typisches Projekt Bei Uns**
* Woche 1: „Kubernetes? Hab ich noch nie produktiv gemacht.“
* Woche 2: Pair Programming mit einem Kollegen, der es kann
* Woche 3: Du erklärst dem Kunden die ersten Konzepte
* Woche 4: Du hilfst dem nächsten Neuen dabei


 So läuft das bei uns. Wissen teilen statt horten.
   

  

**Was Du Mitbringst**
* Grundsolides IT\-Verständnis und erste Erfahrungen (egal ob Cloud, Dev oder Ops)
* Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Dinge einfach zu erklären
* Neugier und den Mut, „dumme“ Fragen zu stellen
* Ein Gespür dafür, wann die 80%\-Lösung besser ist als die perfekte
* Die Erkenntnis, dass auch Kunden und Kollegen nur Menschen sind


**Unternehmerisch Denken Heißt Bei Uns**
* Du verstehst, warum wir manchmal „Nein“ zu Projekten sagen
* Du denkst in Lösungen, nicht in Problemen
* Du weißt, dass deine Arbeit direkt zum Unternehmenserfolg beiträgt
* Du handelst so, als wäre es deine eigene Firma (ist es ja auch ein bisschen)


**Was Wir Dir Bieten**
* Mentoring, das diesen Namen verdient
* Projekte, die zu deinem Skill\-Level passen – mit genug Stretch, um zu wachsen
* Ein Team, das auch mal zusammen kocht/grillt/zockt (freiwillig!)
* Die Chance, deine eigenen Ideen umzusetzen
* Fehlerkultur: Wir lernen aus Mistakes, statt Schuldige zu suchen
* Ein Gehalt, das deine Leistung und Entwicklung fair widerspiegelt


**Der Reality Check**
* Ja, manchmal ist es stressig (aber wir achten aufeinander)
* Ja, du musst auch mal Dinge tun, die keinen Spaß machen (Doku!)
* Nein, wir wissen auch nicht alles (aber wir finden es raus)
* Nein, du musst kein Rockstar/Ninja/Wizard sein (normale Menschen preferred)


**Menschlich Passt Es, Wenn**
* Du lieber im Team gewinnst als alleine glänzt
* Du nach der Arbeit auch mal ein Bier/Club Mate/Tee mit Kollegen trinkst
* Du verstehst, dass „professionell“ und „menschlich“ kein Widerspruch sind


**Interesse? Erzähl uns:**
* Wo du gerade stehst und wo du hinwillst
* Was dich an IT begeistert (und was nervt)
* Warum du bei einem jungen Unternehmen arbeiten willst


 Perfekte CVs interessieren uns weniger als echte Menschen.
   

  

 Bewerben kannst Du Dich unten, übers Formular oder per Mail an info@wikavis.de \*protected email\*
   

  

 P.S.: Wir haben alle mal klein angefangen. Auch der CTO hat mal gegoogelt, was ein Docker Container ist.

title: Quality Process Analyst
description:
**About Tarento:**  

Tarento is a fast\-growing technology consulting company headquartered in Stockholm, with a strong presence in India and clients across the globe. We specialize in digital transformation, product engineering, and enterprise solutions, working across diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. Our teams combine Nordic values with Indian expertise to deliver innovative, scalable, and high\-impact solutions.  

We're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**, a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well\-being and growth. At Tarento, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose. **Role Overview**  

We are seeking a **Quality Process Analyst** with 0–2 years of experience or strong academic exposure to Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and quality processes. The role involves supporting the Quality team in ensuring project adherence to organizational process standards by maintaining project documentation, tracking quality metrics, assisting with process compliance audits, coordinating with project teams, and managing quality\-related records and reports.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

* Support the Quality team in tracking project adherence to Tarento's process standards
* Assist project teams in setting up basic project tracking mechanisms and metrics
* Learn and support process compliance audits under guidance from senior Quality team members
* Help maintain documentation, checklists, and process asset repositories

Coordinate with project teams to collect data needed for quality reviews and reports  
* 

  

**Major Accountability**  

* Assist in setting up project processes like planning trackers and basic metrics dashboards
* Support process compliance audits and work product inspections (as a co\-auditor, under mentorship)
* Help coordinate and document SEPG (Software Engineering Process Group) activities
* Participate in project initiation and knowledge\-sharing sessions
* Maintain records for training completions, audit findings, and closure trackers
* Escalate any gaps or risks observed to the Quality lead / manager / director

Comply with all information security policies and processes  
* 

  

**Essential Skills and Experience**  

* 0\-2 years of experience; freshers with a strong academic record are welcome to apply
* BE/BTech/MCA or equivalent in Computer Science, IT, or a related field
* Basic understanding of SDLC models like Scrum and Waterfall (academic or internship exposure is fine)
* Awareness of quality standards like ISO 9001 or CMMI is a plus, but not mandatory
* Strong attention to detail and a genuine interest in process and quality as a career path
* Good communication skills, since this role means talking to project teams regularly

Comfortable with MS Excel and documentation tools; willingness to learn audit and metrics tools on the job  
* 

  

**What Success Looks Like in 6 Months**  

* Can independently run a basic compliance checklist audit with minimal supervision
* Understands Tarento's process framework well enough to explain it to a new project team
* Has contributed to at least one process improvement idea or SEPG activity

title: Junior Security Engineer, Information Security
company: Ocwen Financial Solutions Pvt. Ltd. - APAC
description:
**Position Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 Security operations team is responsible for ensuring that the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability of the organization are consistently protected. The individual working in the L1 SOC team operates and evaluates security monitoring solutions, responding in a timely manner to security events identified. The role involves applying analytical judgment to assess risks, investigate alerts, and support incident response activities. This position requires working in a shift schedule to provide 24/7 coverage within defined operational frameworks.
   

  

**Job Functions And Responsibilities**
* Monitor, evaluate, and analyze cyber security events from various security tools to identify potential threats and anomalies.
* Triage security events and incidents by applying structured analytical methods, determine severity, and recommend or initiate appropriate remediation actions in alignment with SOC procedures.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and quality of incident information to support effective investigation and resolution.
* Analyze phishing emails reported by internal end users, assess potential impact, and recommend mitigative actions.
* Escalate incidents to the L2 SOC team based on defined criteria, exercising judgment within established governance frameworks.
* Follow up on remediation activities and validate closure to ensure risks are effectively mitigated.
* Triage and manage general information security tickets, ensuring timely and accurate resolution.
* Contribute to process optimization and operational efficiency by identifying recurring issues, gaps, or opportunities for improvement in monitoring and incident handling workflows.
* Drive solution\-oriented outcomes impacting security posture and operational effectiveness through proactive problem\-solving and informed decision\-making.
* Exercise discretion within defined governance frameworks and represent the organization in stakeholder interactions with professionalism and sound judgment.


**Qualifications**
* 1–3 years of progressive experience in areas such as alert monitoring, incident triage, and security event analysis.
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college/university with foundational knowledge of Information Security.
* Demonstrated ability to utilize training, domain expertise, and specialized knowledge to perform responsibilities independently and effectively.
* Strong willingness to learn security technologies and understand evolving security operations practices.
* Reliable, with effective communication skills for documenting and conveying incident\-related information.
* Well\-developed logical and analytical thinking capabilities to investigate and resolve security cases.
* Ability to apply professional judgment to ensure accuracy, compliance, and high\-quality outcomes in deliverables.
* Ability to work in shifts and weekends in a 24/7 operational environment.


**Work Schedule Or Travel Requirements**
 6 AM to 3PM/ 2 PM to 11 PM / 10 PM to 7 AM IST.

title: Network Security
description:
**Experience:** 
 7–10 years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 We are looking for a senior offensive security professional with strong expertise in
 **red team operations, adversary emulation, black\-box network penetration testing, cloud penetration testing, phishing simulations, C2 operations, and custom exploit development** 
 .
   

  

 The role requires hands\-on capability to simulate real\-world attacker behavior, develop attack paths, bypass security controls in authorized environments, and deliver high\-quality technical findings with practical remediation guidance.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead red team, adversary emulation, black\-box network, cloud, and infrastructure penetration testing engagements.
* Plan and execute attack scenarios covering reconnaissance, initial access, exploitation, privilege escalation, lateral movement, persistence, and objective\-based actions.
* Use adversary emulation platforms and C2 frameworks such as Cobalt Strike, Sliver, Mythic, Havoc, Metasploit, and similar tools in authorized assessments.
* Design and execute phishing simulation campaigns, payload delivery scenarios, and initial access simulations.
* Perform custom exploit development, exploit modification, payload customization, and proof\-of\-concept development for identified vulnerabilities.
* Conduct Active Directory and hybrid identity attack simulations, including credential attacks, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and domain compromise scenarios.
* Perform cloud penetration testing across AWS, Azure, and GCP, focusing on IAM abuse, exposed assets, storage misconfigurations, insecure networking, excessive permissions, and privilege escalation paths.
* Assess endpoint, network, identity, cloud, and email security controls from an attacker’s perspective.
* Support purple team and detection validation exercises by mapping techniques to MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Prepare detailed reports covering attack chains, exploited weaknesses, business impact, evidence, and remediation recommendations.
* Present findings and attack narratives to technical teams, leadership, and client stakeholders.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute to red team playbooks, tooling, labs, and methodologies.


**Required Skills**
* Strong hands\-on expertise in red teaming, adversary emulation, black\-box testing, network penetration testing, and cloud pentesting.
* Practical experience with C2 and adversary emulation platforms such as Cobalt Strike, Sliver, Mythic, Havoc, Metasploit, Covenant, or similar frameworks.
* Experience in phishing simulations, payload delivery, social engineering assessments, and initial access simulation.
* Ability to perform custom exploit development, exploit chaining, payload customization, and proof\-of\-concept creation.
* Strong knowledge of Active Directory attack techniques, including Kerberoasting, AS\-REP roasting, NTLM relay, pass\-the\-hash, pass\-the\-ticket, delegation abuse, ACL abuse, and domain escalation paths.
* Good understanding of cloud attack techniques across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including IAM abuse, storage exposure, metadata service abuse, key leakage, role assumption, and privilege escalation.
* Experience with tools such as BloodHound, Mimikatz, Impacket, NetExec/CrackMapExec, Responder, Evilginx, GoPhish, Nmap, Masscan, Nessus, Burp Suite, Wireshark, Hashcat, Hydra, Pacu, Prowler, ScoutSuite, AzureHound, ROADtools etc
* Scripting and automation skills in Python, PowerShell, Bash, Go, or C/C\+\+.
* Good understanding of OPSEC, payload handling, evasion concepts, attack path mapping, and detection\-aware testing.
* Strong reporting, stakeholder communication, and client\-facing skills.


 Good to Have

* Develop and deploy solutions to address key SecOps business requirements and design suitable solutions, challenging requirements where necessary.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Strong foundational knowledge of at least one core security domain (VM, Endpoint, Data Security, etc.).
* Strong foundation knowledge of data storage technologies (NetApp, Isilon/Power Scale) and integration with data security scanning tools.
* Strong knowledge of security network architectures e.g. Firewalls, DMZ, proxies, DNS, web and mail servers, and the principles of networking.
* Career proven history of supporting and being in lead roles of security services at enterprise scale preferably in a regulated environment.
* Enthusiastic about security, open to learning, and to dynamically adapting to Information Security technologies as business requirements change.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To develop, implement and maintain solutions that support the safeguarding of the banks systems and sensitive information.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Provision of subject matter expertise on security systems and engineering patterns.
* Development and implementation of protocols, algorithms, and software applications to protect sensitive data and systems.
* Management and protection of secrets, ensuring that they are securely generated, stored, and used.
* Execution of audits to monitor, identify and assess vulnerabilities in the banks infrastructure/software and support the response to potential security breaches.
* Identification of advancements in to support the innovation and adoption of new cryptographic technologies and techniques.

They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..

They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.

* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. title: Admin Assistant
description:
**Administrative Assistant**

Studio Tunnel — Colour Grading for Ads, Series \& Films · Full\-time, In\-office · Entry\-level (0–2 years)

**Role:** Administrative Assistant

**Reports to:** Studio Head / Operations Lead

**Employment type:** Full\-time, in\-office

**Location:** Santacruz West, Mumbai

**Experience:** 0–2 years (freshers with related internships are welcome)

**About Cineloom Postworks / Studio Tunnel**

*Studio Tunnel is a colour grading studio. We work on advertising films, episodic series and feature films, partnering with directors, cinematographers, agencies and production houses to shape the final look of their work.*

**About the Role**

*We are looking for an organised, dependable Administrative Assistant to keep the day\-to\-day running of the studio smooth. This is the person who makes sure grading sessions are booked, calendars line up, invoices go out on time, and nothing slips through the cracks while the colourists focus on the work.*

*You will sit at the centre of the studio — coordinating between clients, colourists, vendors and our Chartered Accountant. It is a hands\-on role with a lot of variety, and a strong starting point for anyone who wants to build a career in studio operations or post\-production management.*

**Key Responsibilities**

**Scheduling \& Bookings**

* Manage studio and colourist calendars; schedule grading sessions, client review sessions and internal meetings.
* Take booking enquiries, confirm suite slots, and share booking confirmations and schedules with clients.
* Coordinate with colourists and producers so suite bookings, deliverables and availability never clash.

**Invoicing \& Payment Follow\-ups**

* Prepare and issue client invoices accurately and on time.
* Maintain an organised archive of all invoices, receipts and related paperwork.
* Track incoming and outgoing payments and follow up politely and persistently on pending dues.
* Share records, reconcile payment status and coordinate regularly with the studio's Chartered Accountant (CA).

**Communication**

* Answer and route incoming phone calls; take clear messages and follow up on them.
* Manage the studio inbox — draft and send professional emails to clients, vendors and partners.
* Receive, sort and distribute incoming mail and couriers.

**Record Keeping \& Reporting**

* Enter and maintain data accurately across spreadsheets and studio systems.
* Keep digital and physical filing systems organised, named consistently and easy to search.
* Prepare simple reports on bookings, payments and studio activity as required.

**Office Management**

* Track and order studio and office supplies before they run out.
* Greet and assist visitors, clients and crew, and keep common areas presentable.
* Support the team with ad\-hoc administrative and coordination tasks.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Organisation —** Ability to juggle several tasks, deadlines and requests at once without losing track of any of them.
* **Computer skills —** Comfortable with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Calendar, Drive).
* **Communication —** Speaks and writes clearly, politely and professionally with clients, vendors and the team.
* **Attention to detail —** Careful with numbers, dates, names and filing — small errors in invoices and bookings cause big problems.
* **Reliability —** Follows up without being chased, and flags issues early.
* **Discretion —** Handles client information, payment details and studio records with discretion.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior internship or work experience in a post\-production studio, agency or production house.
* Familiarity with invoicing or accounting tools (Tally, Zoho Books, QuickBooks or similar).
* Basic understanding of GST, TDS or invoicing compliance.
* Interest in film, advertising or post\-production — you don't need technical grading knowledge, just curiosity.

**Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline (commerce, business administration or a related field is a plus).
* 0–2 years of experience; freshers with strong organisational skills are encouraged to apply.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

**What We Offer**

* A front\-row seat in a working colour grading studio, and exposure to ad films, series and features as they are finished.
* Direct mentorship from the studio and operations leads.
* Clear ownership of your work from day one, with room to grow into studio operations or post\-production coordination.
* A collaborative, low\-ego team environment.

**How to Apply**

*Send your CV to samiran@studiotunnel.com with the subject line “Administrative Assistant — \[Your Name]”.*

*Studio Tunnel is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds.*

-------------------


We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world's air travel industry.  

You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. Our goal is to find fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to make their operations run like clockwork. Want to be a part of something big?  

Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA. **Ready to redefine air travel? The journey starts here, with you at SITA.**

**ABOUT THE ROLE \& TEAM:**

  

We are seeking a dedicated and motivated individual to join our team as a Apprentice Technician in the IT industry. As an Apprentice Technician, you will have the opportunity to learn and develop skills in troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining computer hardware systems. This is an entry\-level position suitable for individuals with a passion for technology and a desire to kick\-start their career in the field.


In this role, you will work closely with experienced technicians and be exposed to a wide range of computer hardware components and systems. You will provide support and assistance in diagnosing and resolving technical issues, as well as participate in the installation and configuration of computer hardware/Software.

 **WHAT YOU WILL DO:**

* Assist in troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving hardware and software issues
* Perform routine maintenance and repairs on computer systems, including replacing faulty components
* Install, configure, and test computer hardware components and peripherals
* Assist in the monitoring and maintenance of network security systems.
* Troubleshoot network issues and perform necessary repairs or replacements.
* Assist in the installation of computer networks, including routers, switches, and firewalls.
* Provide technical support to end\-users in a timely and efficient manner
* Collaborate with team members to ensure the smooth operation of SITA systems
* Keep accurate records of repairs, maintenance tasks, and inventory
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in computer hardware technology and industry trends.


Qualifications:
**EXPERIENCE:**

  

No prior experience required. Freshers or candidates with limited hands\-on experience are encouraged to apply.

**EDUCATION \& QUALIFICATIONS**
-------------------------------

* Diploma, Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field equivalent.
* Excellent problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills
* Basic knowledge of computer hardware components and systems
* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions
* Good communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Basic knowledge of network hardware, including routers, switches, and firewalls.
* Should be flexible to work evenings or weekends as required.
* This role requires flexibility to work in rotating shifts, including night shifts.
* Ability to stay composed and perform effectively in high\-pressure environments.


Freshers or candidates with limited hands\-on experience are encouraged to apply.

* Must be able to adapt quickly to new processes, tools, and technologies.
* Having valid Indian passport will be an advantage.

**WHAT WE OFFER**
-----------------

  

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.  

**Employee Wellbeing:** We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health \- a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.  

**Professional Development:** At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world\-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** and **Airport Council International** \-available to all employees\-to specialized solutions like **Pluralsight** for technology upskilling, **Harvard Business Publishing** for people leadership, **Stanford** for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.  

**Competitive Benefits:** Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status. *SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self\-identify in the application process.*

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **8th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

title: Branch Services
description:
At Franklin Templeton, we’re driving our industry forward by developing new and innovative ways to help our clients achieve their investment goals. Our dynamic and diversified firm spans asset management, wealth management, and fintech, offering many ways to help investors make progress toward their goals. Our talented teams working around the globe bring expertise that’s both broad and unique. From our welcoming, inclusive, and flexible culture to our global and diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential but also to contribute to our clients’ achievements.

**Come join us in delivering better outcomes for our clients around the world!**

***About the GSS\-India:***

* Our GSS India team delivers a wide range of shared services and operational support functions to business units and stakeholders across the organization. We manage critical processes, ensure adherence to policies and processes, support process improvements and standardization initiatives, and provide timely resolution of customer queries. The team collaborates closely with internal and external stakeholders to enhance service quality, drive efficiency, and support business objectives through continuous improvement and digital transformation initiatives. Joining us offers broad exposure to global operations, cross\-functional collaboration, process excellence, and opportunities to develop expertise in shared services, stakeholder management, and business process optimization.

***What is the role of Branch Service?***
=========================================


Effective management of calls, walk\-ins, letters and email queries. Handle critical relationships by providing exceptional service support. Liaison with CAMS for enabling seamless service delivery to our clients.

* Effective management of operational activities of branch.

***What are the ongoing responsibilities of Customer Service?***
================================================================

* Meet the critical distributors on predefined frequency, foster relationships, and deliver exemplary service experience to our distributors.
* Effective Tracking of all the queries and ensure thorough NIGO checks,
* Effective use of data, MIS by adding value by creating talking points during all scheduled interactions with the distributors.
* Answers queries including but not limited to processing of transactions, processes, regulatory \& compliance guidelines from distributors, financial advisors, and other interested parties either from an incoming call or an outgoing returned call.
* Keeps abreast of current market conditions, fund and company policies, investment and tax law changes, compliance requirements, and all other procedural information in a constantly changing environment.
* Adheres to all legal requirements (compliance rules) while servicing distributors.
* Maintain effective channels of communication with all CAMS/KARVY POS for effective delivery of services to our distributors.
* Share monthly statistics with distributors on error trends at their level (Monthly Distributor Service Level Report)
* Preparation of monthly MIS to error trends and measure improvement
* Be flexible for switching job profile within the team.
* Should be a good team player.
* Build a good rapport with the stakeholders.
* Need to take care of operational activities of the branch.

***What ideal qualifications, skills \& experience would help someone to be successful?***
==========================================================================================

* Preferred MBA or any graduate degree. Preferably from a commerce / accounting / finance background. Proficient in English, numerate.
* Fresher or 1\-2 years of relevant experience in the financial services industry and mutual funds in specific.
* Good writing and verbal communication skills
* Good presentation skills
* Capacity to handle high volume of activity in fast\-paced environment.
* Strong interpersonal skills; interact effectively with all levels including senior management
* Ability to work collaboratively within teams to achieve results and also adept at working independently with moderate supervision.

**Work Shift Timings \- 9:00 AM \- 6:00 PM IST**

**Experience our welcoming culture and reach your professional and personal potential!**
========================================================================================


Our culture is shaped by our diverse global workforce and strongly held core values. Regardless of your interests, lifestyle, or background, there’s a place for you at Franklin Templeton. We provide employees with the tools, resources, and learning opportunities to help them excel in their career and personal life.


Hear more from our employees

  

  

By joining us, you will become part of a culture that focuses on employee well\-being and provides multidimensional support for a positive and healthy lifestyle. We understand that benefits are at the core of employee well\-being and may vary depending on individual needs. Whether you need support for maintaining your physical and mental health, saving for life’s adventures, taking care of your family members, or making a positive impact in your community, we aim to have them covered.

***Highlights of our benefits include:***

* Professional development growth opportunities through in\-house classes and over 150 Web\-based training courses
* An educational assistance program to financially help employees seeking continuing education
* Medical, Life and Personal Accident Insurance benefit for employees. Medical insurance also cover employee’s dependents (spouses, children and dependent parents)
* Life insurance for protection of employees’ families
* Personal accident insurance for protection of employees and their families
* Personal loan assistance
* Employee Stock Investment Plan (ESIP)
* 12 weeks Paternity leave

**Learn more about the wide range of benefits we offer at Franklin Templeton**


Franklin Templeton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and existing employees, and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to ancestry, age, color, disability, genetic information, gender, gender identity, or gender expression, marital status, medical condition, military or veteran status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, and any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law, ordinance, or regulation.  

  

Franklin Templeton is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment. If you believe that you need an accommodation or adjustment to search for or apply for one of our positions, please send an email to accommodations@franklintempleton.com. In your email, please include the accommodation or adjustment you are requesting, the job title, and the job number you are applying for. It may take up to three business days to receive a response to your request. Please note that only accommodation requests will receive a response.

description:
**Job Title**

 **Territory Service Representative – Operations**

 **Function**

Inbound Shift In\-charge / Outbound Shift In\-charge (as applicable)

 **Location**

 **Branch / Service Centre (Location Agnostic)**

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**

  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**

  


The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

**Job Purpose:**

  


To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**

  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

**Qualifications \& Experience:**

  

**Education**:

* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**

  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance

**Key Performance Indicators:**

  

**KRAs**

 **KPIs**

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency

  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**

  


When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths**across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**
