title: Vulnerability Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 At Domino, we build software that helps the largest, AI\-driven organizations build and operate advanced data science and AI solutions at scale. Our platform integrates a streamlined model development environment, MLOps capabilities, and novel features for collaboration, reuse, and reproducibility — all of which make data science teams more productive, reduce time to value, and ensure compliance. Our customers — like Johnson \& Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. Especially in the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit www.domino.ai
   

  

**What We Are Building**
 Domino's Security team safeguards a platform trusted by some of the most regulated organizations in the world, across financial services, pharma, government, and defense. Vulnerability Management is where that trust gets tested day to day: finding, triaging, and closing out risk across our OS, container, and dependency surface, and giving customers a clear, defensible answer when they ask how exposed they are. This role joins that function as it scales, working closely with our Staff Security Engineer to turn a fast\-growing vulnerability workload into faster, more consistent risk assessments.
   

  

**What Your Impact Will Be**
 In your first year, your impact will be:
   

  

* Faster, more consistent Vulnerability Risk Assessments. You'll own first\-pass CVSS scoring and exploitability analysis, closing the SLA gap between finding and answer
* Validated, trustworthy triage. You'll reproduce and confirm customer\-reported and pen\-test findings before they reach Engineering, so fix priority reflects real exploitability, not just scanner severity
* Reliable scanning pipelines. You'll keep SAST/DAST and vulnerability scanning automations running, troubleshooting failures and tuning configs so the data everyone relies on stays clean
* Real partnership with Engineering. You'll build or run PoC exploits on select CVEs, bringing validated risk, not just findings, into prioritization conversations
* More capacity for the function. You'll free up our Staff Security Engineer to focus on program\-level improvement instead of carrying all of vulnerability management's day\-to\-day load


**What We Look For In This Role**
* Hands\-on experience managing vulnerabilities for a large SaaS product, across OS, container, and dependency exposure
* A track record triaging and tracking CVEs for a SaaS or containerized product: reading scan reports, prioritizing by severity, and following through to resolution
* Experience reproducing and validating reported vulnerabilities, whether from customer disclosures or pen test findings, not just logging them
* Time spent with vulnerability scanning tools such as Prisma Cloud/Twistlock, JFrog, or Trivy, including reconciling findings across tools
* Comfort building or maintaining SAST/DAST pipeline automation, and triaging what the scans turn up
* Experience partnering with Engineering to get fixes prioritized and shipped, not just reported
* Background in a highly regulated environment or modern software company, ideally one that moves at startup or scale\-up speed
* Strong scripting ability, Python preferred
* Working knowledge of CVSS v3\.1/v4\.0 scoring and the judgment to assess risk, not just report it
* Exploit development or PoC skills to validate real\-world exploitability of CVEs, using tools like Burp Suite
* Familiarity with OWASP Top 10 and testing methodology
* Working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes, plus core Linux, AWS, and networking fundamentals
* Basic understanding of authentication/authorization concepts (tokens, session handling, auth bypass patterns) and API security fundamentals
* Basic threat modeling: thinking in attack paths, not just isolated severity scores
* Clear communication, comfortable navigating risk conversations with Engineering and customers, including drafting risk statements a non\-technical audience will actually read
* Comfort operating with ambiguity, since not every finding arrives with a clean severity or fix path


**Nice To Have**
* OSWA, OSWE, or a similar offensive security certification (e.g. GWAPT, GPEN)
* Familiarity with Airflow and Snowflake


**What We Value**
* We value a growth mindset. High\-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and see the opportunities for success
* We believe in individuals who seek truth and speak the truth and can be their whole selves at work
* We value all of you that believe improving is always possible At Domino Everything is a work in progress – we can do better at everything
* We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company
* We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply

 Percentage of remediations successfully validated
   

  

 Reduction in repeat findings

description:
Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands.
   

  

 At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education \& Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.
   

  

 ,
   

  

 The Associate, Retail Store Systems Support provides dedicated technical support for Ralph Lauren Retail Stores, covering POS computer systems, hardware, and software via telephone, email, and chat tools. This position is fast\-paced and multi\-task intensive, requiring excellent decision making and top\-notch customer service skills. Strong expertise in Windows systems and the ability to confidently troubleshoot over the phone are essential to success in this role.
   

  

 Working as part of a team, successful candidates will share our values and have an interest in working with the latest technologies to provide exceptional customer service to all Retail Stores in North America, EMEA, and some countries in APAC.
   

  

 ,
   

  

**General**
* Serve as the first point of contact for Retail Stores seeking assistance with POS hardware, software, workstations, printers, time clocks, UPS units, mobile devices, interactive screens, or other retail technology issues.
* Deliver clear, confident troubleshooting over the phone, guiding non\-technical store users step by step to resolution.
* Provide 24x7 support of applications for Retail Stores and participate in a rotating on\-call schedule for off\-hour and weekend coverage.
* Apply a logical approach and structured process to problem solving.
* Participate in product and process updates, and create documentation for the same.
* Proactively drive issues to closure and collaborate with peers to resolve them.
* Communicate problems clearly to your team and colleagues, and understand how issues affect other areas of the organization beyond IT.
* Acknowledge and action proactive monitoring alerts as a first responder, escalating where required.
* Take independent action – do things before being asked or forced by events – and contribute creative solutions and innovative ideas.


**Operational**
* Be an advocate for customer requests; maintain ownership of each request and follow through consistently to resolution.
* Increase Retail Store satisfaction by improving the First Contact Resolution (FCR) rate.
* Review open ticket queues and close tickets upon resolution daily.
* Triage and prioritize issues appropriately, and escalate problems to management when needed.
* Stay current with system information, changes, and updates.


 Applications \& Technology Expertise
   

  

**Must Have**
* High expertise in Windows 10 troubleshooting, with a strong overall understanding of both Windows and iOS platforms.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot over the phone and through remote support channels.
* Azure Active Directory – hands\-on experience.
* Networking – basic knowledge (connectivity, Wi\-Fi, and store network fundamentals).
* ITIL – basic knowledge of incident, request, and escalation processes, including an understanding of ticket prioritization and parent/child ticket relationships.
* ServiceNow – basic to intermediate (ticket logging, categorization, routing, and queue management).
* Retail hardware and POS setup – basic to intermediate (registers, receipt printers, barcode scanners, PIN pads, UPS units).
* Xstore POS – working knowledge of Level 1 troubleshooting (login, register, receipt printing, and open/close issues).
* Microsoft 365, Outlook, and SharePoint – working knowledge, with strong Excel skills.


**Good To Have**
* Exposure to proactive POS monitoring tools (e.g., HAWK) for alert acknowledgement and first response.
* Adyen and payment device troubleshooting – basic knowledge.
* Intune MDM – basic knowledge.
* IBM iSeries – foundation skills.
* TrueVue / RFID – basic knowledge.
* Exposure to connected retail applications such as Mad Mobile, Concierge, RetailNext, or Yoobic.
* SQL / Oracle – basic query and troubleshooting knowledge.


 ,
   

  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to support store users across global regions over the phone.
* Strong customer service orientation and sound decision making in a fast\-paced, multi\-task environment.
* Logical problem\-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
* Collaborative team player who builds strong working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.
* Proactive mindset with a “can do” attitude.
* Strong time management and prioritization skills.


 Mandatory Requirements
   

  

* Minimum 1 year of experience in ITES operations.
* Adaptability to work in rotational shifts as part of a 24x7 support model, which can include nights and weekends.

**About The Role**
 Eltropy's IT \& Security team keeps a globally distributed workforce productive and secure while operating in a SOC 2\-audited, compliance\-driven environment. We're looking for an IT System Administrator to own day\-to\-day IT operations for our India team and to help move broader IT initiatives forward.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role for someone who takes full ownership of their work. You'll run endpoint management, identity administration, new\-hire onboarding, and end\-user support, while partnering with IT \& Security colleagues across regions on projects that improve how the whole company operates. The ideal candidate is extremely detail\-oriented, accountable, and proactive \- someone who thrives on owning problems end to end. Because this role supports users and data across regions, strong judgment around data handling, access control, and compliance is essential.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* Extremely detail\-oriented. You catch the small things, double\-check your work, and don't let items slip through the cracks.
* Accountable. You take ownership of your tasks end to end and follow through without needing to be chased.
* Proactive. You anticipate problems, raise them early, and look for ways to improve rather than waiting to be told.
* A driver. You're comfortable owning day\-to\-day operations and pushing IT initiatives forward alongside the team.


**Role \& Responsibilities**
* Own new\-hire onboarding and offboarding: account and access provisioning, device preparation, and a smooth day\-one experience.
* Manage laptop procurement, imaging, shipping, tracking, and asset lifecycle for the India team and distributed staff.
* Provide responsive macOS and Windows end\-user support via the ticketing system (Zendesk), resolving issues within SLA.
* Administer Microsoft Entra ID: user and group lifecycle, authentication, Conditional Access, and role\-based access control.
* Manage the macOS fleet in Kandji and the Windows fleet in Microsoft Intune: enrollment, configuration, app deployment, and patch/update management.
* Administer Google Workspace: user provisioning, group and shared drive management, and collaboration tools.
* Support SSO and SCIM provisioning across SaaS applications; troubleshoot identity and access issues.
* Perform basic networking tasks: configuring and troubleshooting access points, switches, and routers.
* Support security and compliance operations: access reviews, endpoint hardening, MFA enforcement, and SOC 2 evidence collection.
* Run day\-to\-day IT operations for the India team while contributing to and helping drive company\-wide IT initiatives and projects.
* Develop and maintain clear documentation, runbooks, and SOPs for IT systems and processes.
* Stay current on emerging technologies and recommend improvements to reliability, security, and efficiency.


**Qualifications Required**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field \- or equivalent practical experience.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on IT/systems administration experience.
* Strong macOS and Windows troubleshooting across hardware, software, and cloud services.
* Proficiency administering Microsoft Entra ID (users, groups, authentication, Conditional Access, access control).
* Proficiency with Kandji MDM for macOS device management (enrollment, configuration profiles, software deployment, patching, compliance).
* Demonstrated ability to own new\-hire onboarding end to end and to handle laptop shipping, imaging, and asset logistics for a distributed workforce.
* Strong written and verbal English communication, with a habit of documenting work.
* Availability to overlap with other regions' working hours as needed.


**Additional Skills That Are a Plus**
* Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar control frameworks and access reviews.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Intune for Windows management.
* Familiarity with SCIM provisioning, SSO integrations, and identity governance.

* Experience administering Zendesk or a comparable ITSM/ticketing platform.

* Assist with the installation, configuration, maintenance, and operational support of network hardware, software, and connectivity services.
* Monitor network performance, respond to incidents and service requests, and troubleshoot network and firewall issues.
* Support network upgrades, patching activities, access control list updates, and firewall rule testing in alignment with established standards.
* Maintain network documentation, technical reports, standard operating procedures, and inventory information.
* Work with senior network engineers, internal stakeholders, and external teams on deployments, migrations, security measures, and day\-to\-day network operations.


**The team**
 The T\&I Networks team is part of Deloitte’s Technology \& Infrastructure organization and supports core network services across the enterprise. The team manages key network capabilities including routing, switching, firewalls, wireless, load balancing, domain services, and infrastructure security. Team members work with internal technology teams and business stakeholders to help deliver reliable, secure, and scalable network operations.
   

  

**Location: Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings: 2 PM to 11 PM or as needed**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree.
* 1\-3 years of experience in network technologies.
* Experience with enterprise network operations, incident response, or network troubleshooting.
* Experience with one or more of the following: firewall administration, routing and switching, wireless networking, or software\-defined wide area network platforms.
* Experience using network monitoring tools or maintaining network documentation.
* Entry\-level certification such as CompTIA Network\+ or Cisco Certified Network Associate.


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience with Check Point or Palo Alto firewalls.
* Experience with Cisco Meraki, Cisco switching, or Cisco wireless technologies.
* Experience with Cisco Software\-Defined Wide Area Network, Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol, or Domain Name System platforms.
* Experience with F5 application delivery controllers or Infoblox Domain Name System.
* Experience supporting Windows or Linux server connectivity in a network environment.


**Our purpose**

The company's specialized workforce solutions meet clients' needs for a reliable, efficient workforce in a wide variety of industries including \- construction, manufacturing, financial services, pharmaceuticals, transportation, aviation, and energy. TrueBlue assigns as many as 100,000 people to work each day, drawing from a data base of hundreds of thousands of candidates, and places more than 250,000 people in permanent positions each year.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking a skilled and dedicated Systems Administrator to manage, maintain, and troubleshoot our organization's IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with systems administration, security tools, and technologies such as Linux and Windows systems, VMWare, Veeam Backup, Tape Backup solutions, and MS SQL Server. 8. Backup and Recovery: Configure and manage backup systems using Veeam, tape backup, and other data protection technologies to ensure regular, reliable backups and rapid recovery in the event of a disaster.
9. Documentation \& Reporting: Maintain up\-to\-date documentation on network and system configurations, procedures, and incident reports. Provide regular status updates for management regarding IT infrastructure, health and performance.

 Experience:

* Experience of MS SQL Server \& Oracle Database, configuration, optimization, and maintenance.



 Upgrades \& patching

title: Associate Network Engineer
description:
Role Summary
   

  

  


 The Associate Network Engineer will support the implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting of Yakkaservices’ network and communication infrastructure across offices and project sites. The role will assist in managing LAN, Wi\-Fi, firewall, VPN, IP telephony, CCTV, IPIS network connectivity, and endpoint network access to ensure secure and reliable business operations.
   

  




 Key Responsibilities
   

  

  

  

 1\. Network Infrastructure Support
   

  

  

* Assist in configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting LAN, WAN, VLAN, Wi\-Fi, and internet connectivity.
* Support network setup for branch offices, project sites, and temporary site locations.
* Maintain structured connectivity for desktops, laptops, IP phones, printers, CCTV, access control, and other network devices.
* Support single\-cable desk connectivity where IP Phone and laptop share the same network point using separate VLANs.


 2\. Firewall, VPN, and Security Support
   

  

  

* Assist in managing Fortinet firewall policies, routing, NAT, VPN, and access rules.
* Support FortiClient VPN configuration for employees and remote users.
* Monitor basic firewall alerts and escalate suspicious activity to senior IT team members.
* Ensure users and devices are connected through approved secure network access methods.


 3\. Switching and VLAN Management
   

  

  

* Assist in configuration and troubleshooting of managed switches.
* Support VLAN segmentation for corporate data, voice, CCTV, guest Wi\-Fi, access control, and site networks.
* Help maintain port mapping, switch documentation, and device connectivity records.
* Coordinate with vendors for switch, firewall, and network hardware\-related support.


 4\. Wi\-Fi and Guest Network Support
   

  

  

* Support Fortinet\-based corporate and guest Wi\-Fi networks.
* Assist in captive portal configuration and user access control for guest users.
* Troubleshoot Wi\-Fi coverage, authentication, and performance issues.
* Monitor access point health and escalate hardware or configuration issues.


 5\. IP Telephony and Communication Systems
   

  

  

* Support IP phone connectivity, extension configuration, and basic troubleshooting.
* Assist in maintaining centralized Matrix IP PBX and SIP connectivity across offices and sites.
* Support softphone users and remote communication setup where applicable.
* Coordinate with telecom and PBX vendors for issue resolution.


 6\. CCTV, Access Control, and ELV Network Support
   

  

  

* Support network connectivity for CCTV cameras, NVRs, access control panels, PA systems, and other ELV devices.
* Assist in centralized CCTV monitoring connectivity from the head office.
* Troubleshoot basic camera/access control network issues in coordination with the ELV team.
* Ensure network segmentation and secure access for ELV systems.


 7\. IT Service Management and Documentation
   

  

  

* Log, update, and close network\-related tickets.
* Maintain documentation for IP address allocation, VLANs, network diagrams, firewall rules, VPN users, and device inventory.
* Assist in preparing network handover documents for new offices and project sites.
* Follow IT policies, change management procedures, and approval workflows.


 8\. Vendor and Site Coordination
   

  

  

* Coordinate with ISPs, firewall vendors, PBX vendors, and project/site teams for issue resolution.
* Assist in new office/site network readiness checks.
* Support installation, testing, and commissioning of network devices at office and project locations.
* Ensure proper labeling and basic quality checks during network implementation.


 Requirements
   

  

  

 Required Skills
   

  

  

* Basic understanding of networking concepts: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VLAN, routing, switching, VPN, and Wi\-Fi.
* Hands\-on knowledge of routers, switches, access points, firewalls, and structured cabling.
* Basic troubleshooting skills for internet, LAN, Wi\-Fi, and VPN issues.
* Familiarity with Fortinet firewall, FortiClient, FortiAP, and managed switches will be preferred.
* Understanding of IP phones, CCTV networks, access control networks, and ELV systems will be an added advantage.
* Ability to maintain technical documentation clearly.


 Qualification
   

  

  

* Diploma / Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, ECE, Networking, or related field.
* CCNA certification will be preferred but not mandatory.


 Experience
   

  

  

* 0–4 years of experience in network support, IT infrastructure, ELV networking, or system administration.
* Freshers with strong networking knowledge and practical exposure may also be considered.



  

  

  

  




 Benefits
   

  

* Competitive Salary based on experience.
* Performance\-based incentives and career growth opportunities.
* Training and skill development programs.
* Paid leaves and public holidays.
* Health and wellness benefits.
* Collaborative and professional work environment.

description:
**Location: India, Delhi (Remote)**
**Big Ideas. Real People.**
 At Orca, in the right environment and with the right team, talent has no boundaries. This team spirit, together with our drive to always aim high, has quickly earned us unicorn status and turned us into a global cloud security innovation leader. So if you're ready to join an amazing team of people who inspire each other every day, now is the time to find your place in our pod.
   

  

 We're looking for driven and talented people like you to join our CS team and our mission to change the future of cloud security.
 **Ready to dive in and swim with our pod?**
**Highlights:**
* **High\-growth:** 
 Over the past seven years, we've consistently achieved milestones that take other companies a decade or more. During this time, we've significantly grown our employee base, expanded our customer reach, and rapidly advanced our product capabilities.
* **Disruptive innovation:** 
 Our founders saw that traditional security didn't work for the cloud, so they set out to carve a new path. We're relentless pioneers who invented agentless technology and continue to be the most comprehensive and innovative cloud security company.
* **Well\-capitalized:** 
 With a valuation of $1\.8 billion, Orca is a cybersecurity unicorn dominating the cloud security space. We're backed by an impressive team of investors such as Capital G, ICONIQ, GGV, and SVCI, a syndicate of CISOs who invest their own money after conducting their due diligence.
* **Respectful and transparent culture:** 
 Our executives pride themselves on being accessible to everyone and believe in sharing knowledge with the employees. Each employee has a place in shaping the future of our industry.


**About the Role:**
 We're looking for an Associate Customer Success Engineer to join our Customer Success Engineering team. This is a great next step for someone with 1–3 years of experience in a customer\-facing technical role who wants to grow into a career in cloud security and customer success engineering.
   

  

 You'll work alongside senior CSEs and Customer Success Managers to support Orca customers day\-to\-day, helping them get value from the platform, troubleshooting technical questions, and learning the ins and outs of cloud security along the way. You won't be thrown into the deep end: you'll be paired with experienced teammates, given structured ramp\-up time, and coached as you take on more complex accounts and conversations.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
* Serve as a front\-line technical point of contact for a portfolio of small\-to\-mid\-size customer accounts, with support from senior CSEs on more complex issues.
* Help customers troubleshoot platform questions, configuration, integrations, alert findings, and basic cloud environment issues, in partnership with Support and Engineering.
* Assist with customer onboarding: environment connections, initial configuration, and getting new customers to their first "aha moment" with the platform.
* Support Customer Success Managers by preparing technical materials for check\-ins, business reviews, and renewal conversations.
* Shadow and, over time, co\-lead technical workshops and architecture discussions with customers.
* Document recurring issues, build internal runbooks, and contribute to the CSE knowledge base as you learn.
* Track and escalate product issues and feature gaps to Product and Engineering, and follow up with customers on resolution.
* Build foundational knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and the broader CNAPP / cloud security space.


**What We're Looking For:**
* 1–3 years of experience in a customer facing technical role \- e.g., Technical Support Engineer, Support/Solutions Engineer, Implementation Engineer, junior DevOps or Security Engineer, or similar.
* Working familiarity with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP), hands\-on project or lab experience counts.
* Comfort reading logs, APIs, and basic scripts (Python or Bash) to help diagnose issues; you don't need to be a developer, but you shouldn't be afraid of the command line.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills \- you can explain a technical concept clearly to both an engineer and a non\-technical stakeholder.
* A genuine curiosity about cybersecurity and cloud infrastructure, and eagerness to build deeper expertise on the job.
* Comfortable managing multiple customer conversations at once and prioritizing under some ambiguity.
* Based in or able to work from our Delhi or Bangalore hub (preferred); open to some schedule overlap with customers in other time zones (e.g., US/EU) as needed.


**Nice to Have:**
* Exposure to containers/Kubernetes fundamentals.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform).
* A cloud certification (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner/Solutions Architect Associate, Azure Fundamentals, GCP Associate).
* Prior exposure to security concepts (vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, compliance frameworks), not required, we'll teach this.
